data.name: Lutfiah
data.gender_notes: Lutfiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lutfiah is derived from the Arabic word 'lutf', which means 'gentleness' or 'tenderness'. The name Lutfiah carries the meaning “Gentleness, Tenderness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lutfiah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentleness, tenderness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Lutfiah symbolizes the gentle and tender nature of Allah's mercy and compassion.
data.etymology: Lutfiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentleness, Tenderness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lutfiah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It is a beautiful and poetic name that shows the importance of compassion and love in Islamic values. Lutfiah is also a reminder of the gentle nature of Allah (SWT) towards His creation and the compassionate demeanor that believers are encouraged to emulate.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Lutfiah has deep significance for Muslims. In Islamic teachings, gentleness and tenderness are virtues cherished by Allah (SWT). The Prophet Muhammad (SAW) said, "Allah is gentle and loves gentleness" (Bukhari and Muslim). By giving a child this name, parents are reminding them of the importance of being gentle and compassionate in their actions towards others and towards themselves. They are encouraging their child to grow into a person who embodies the loving and merciful nature of Allah (SWT). Therefore, Lutfiah is not just a beautiful name, but it also serves as a constant reminder of Allah's compassion and the importance of showing it to others.
